name: click-ripple
title: Click Ripple
description: Sends rings of the primary color out from every click inside an area, on a click-through layer. Off on touch screens and under reduced motion.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the area. Clicks reach it as usual.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter the rings grow to, in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds one ring takes to grow and fade.

props.name: rings
props.description: Rings sent out by each click.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between rings of the same click.
